# ADR 0027: Alembic Migrations Autogenerated from ORM Metadata

## Context

The schema has to evolve without hand-writing DDL apart from the models.

## Decision

Alembic, with `target_metadata` set to the models' metadata. Revisions are autogenerated, then read and corrected by hand before being committed. The connection comes from the application's own URL builder.

## Consequences

Routine changes are generated. Autogenerate's blind spots (renames, CHECK constraints, data migrations, NOT NULL on full tables) must be caught in review.
